One barri loses: Sant Gervasi - la Bonanova (90.8% against

Sources: databases/barcelona/citylp_local_summary.csv and citylp_local_species.csv (scripts/city_lp.py --local-ceiling, joint layout S4_s1.00_w0.00_r0.00); outlines: Ajuntament de Barcelona, Open Data BCN (CC BY
4.0). Heat = effective-shade proxy, not UTCI; city mix = S1a, the city's 2026 replacement mix placed by its sidewalk rule.
